title: Bachelorette Parties
metaTitle: Bachelorette Party Venue in San Diego | Mission Beach
description: Plan a San Diego bachelorette party at Miss B's Coconut Club in Mission Beach with tropical cocktails, brunch, reserved sections and private-event options steps from the Pacific.
cardDesc: A Mission Beach bachelorette setting with tropical cocktails, brunch, reserved sections and private-event options at 3704 Mission Blvd.
body: Miss B's Coconut Club gives San Diego bachelorette groups a Mission Beach home base with an open-air bar, outdoor patio, coastal dining room and cocktail program at 3704 Mission Blvd.
Plan a brunch gathering, reserved section or larger private event depending on your headcount. Food and cocktail options can be coordinated with the events team for the group.
